steering_coefficient_sweep.details: FAIL. A sweep was performed and α was correctly expressed in σ_proj units via projection std computation (scripts/m5_steer.py:240, 250). However, the block fails on multiple required criteria. First, there is no independent capability/coherence metric logged at each sweep point: the only auxiliary metric is off_digit_rate (scripts/m5_steer.py:284-287, 305), which is merely a coarse collapse proxy, not a proper capability metric such as perplexity, unrelated-task accuracy, or fluency. Second, the target effect is within the baseline-noise floor: across all reported runs (diff_of_means and lda, seeds 42 and 123), mean_conf changes only ~1–1.5 units over the full α range [-4,+4]×σ_proj while the per-point std is ~41, yielding no usable plateau with target clearly above noise. Third, no locked α was selected at all, so no mid-plateau choice exists. Fourth, no random-direction control was run (n_random=0). The sweep spans 7 grid points but only ~1.5 orders of magnitude in absolute α. While there is no evidence of collapse (off_digit_rate stays 0), absence of a real capability metric and the effect being drowned by noise are sufficient for FAIL under the stated criteria.
